assets.questionText: Hi! I'm Marco. What's your name?
Nice to meet you! I'm Marco. Could you tell me a little about yourself?
What's your hobby?
What's your hobby? What do you like about it?
I want to visit Korea. What's your favorite place there?
If I visit Korea, what place should I see first?
Do you like washing dishes or cleaning the floor?
Which chores do you prefer? I can wash dishes or clean the floor.
When should we clean our room?
How often should we clean the room, and which day works best?
Do you sleep early or late?
I'm often awake late. What time should quiet hours start? I can take phone calls outside after that.
Let's meet this weekend! Is Saturday or Sunday better?
We should hang out this weekend. Which day works better for you?
Do you want to go to a park or a cafe?
Would you rather relax at a cafe or do something outside?
Great! What time should we meet?
Tell me what time and place would be easy for you.
I see the $100 charge. Were you away for all of July?
I found the $100 July charge. Please tell me when you left and returned.
Can you send us your plane ticket or hotel booking?
We need proof that you were away. Could you send a plane ticket or booking confirmation?
We can return the money in two weeks. Is that okay?
After we check it, the refund will take about two weeks. Would that work for you?
Can my friends visit our room on Friday evening?
I'd like to invite two friends on Friday evening. Is that okay, or should we choose another time?
Should I ask before I use your things?
What things can we share, and what should we always ask before using?
Should we keep the room quiet after ten at night?
What time should quiet hours start on weeknights? I can use headphones after that.
Hi, I'm Chloe. What's your name?
Hi, I'm Chloe. How are you enjoying the party?
What food do you like at this party?
What kind of music or food do you like at parties?
There's another party next week. Do you want to come?
My friend has a party next week. Would you like to join us?
What do you like to do with your family?
What do you enjoy doing with your family or close friends?
What job do you want in the future?
What kind of work would you like to do someday?
What makes you happy these days?
Is there anything simple that has made you happy lately?
Hi, can I sit here? I'm Marco. What's your name?
Hi, is this seat free? I'm Marco. What should I call you?
What do you want to learn in this class?
What made you choose this class?
What is your favorite class at school?
What is one thing you like about school in Korea?
Do you want to speak or make the slides?
Would you rather present, make the slides, or find information for our project?
Have you spoken in front of a class before?
Have you presented in English before? How did it go?
Should we meet on Monday or Tuesday?
Monday afternoon and Tuesday evening both work for me. When should we meet?
Please tell me which part of your grade you want to ask about.
Tell me which part of the grade surprised you most, and I will explain it.
Your ideas were good, but the examples were short. Can you add more examples next time?
Your main idea was clear, but you needed stronger examples. How could you improve that next time?
Do you want my feedback by email or in person tomorrow?
I can send detailed feedback by email or meet tomorrow. Which would help you more?
Do you study in the morning or at night?
When do you study best, and where do you usually study?
Can we study chapter five together?
Chapter five is difficult for me. Could we review it together after class?
If we study together, should we meet at the library after class?
If we study together, would the library at four or the cafe at five work better?
What makes you happy: good food, fun games, or time with friends?
Money can buy food, games, and trips. Which of these can make people happy?
Can money buy some of those things?
Do you think money makes life easier? Give one simple example.
What is one happy thing that costs no money?
What free activity can make a person happy? Give one example.
Hi! Do you like quiet flights or talking with the person next to you?
Hi, I'm sitting next to you. Do you prefer a quiet flight or some conversation?
Do you like window seats or aisle seats?
Do you prefer window or aisle seats, and what do you like about them?
Where are you going, and what will you do there?
Where are you headed, and what are you planning to do there?
I'm sorry. Can you show me the broken part?
I'm sorry about the damage. Please show me the broken part and explain the problem.
We can give you money or a travel coupon. Which do you want?
We can offer cash, miles, or a travel voucher. Which kind of compensation would you prefer?
Is there anything else I can help you with?
Is there anything else I can help you with?
Welcome! What name is the reservation under?
Welcome to the hotel. Could I have the name on your reservation?
Your room will be ready in one hour. Is that okay?
Your room needs one more hour. Would you like to wait here or leave your bags with us?
Do you want a high floor or a low floor?
Would you prefer a higher floor or a room away from the elevator?
Hi. Would you like to get coffee with me?
Hi, sorry to stop you. Would you be interested in getting coffee sometime?
I understand. Do you want me to leave now?
No problem. Would you prefer that I leave you alone?
Okay. Have a nice day!
I understand. Thanks for being clear, and have a good day.
Hi! What drink would you like?
Welcome! What would you like to drink today?
Do you want it hot or cold?
Would you like it hot or iced, and what size would you like?
Will you drink it here or take it with you?
Is that for here or to go?
Hello. Where does it hurt?
Hello. Please tell me where it hurts and how you feel right now.
We have pills or liquid medicine. Which is easier for you?
This medicine comes as tablets or liquid. Which type would be easier for you?
Please follow the directions on the label. Do you need help reading them?
Please follow the dose on the label. Would you like me to explain when and how to take it?
Use the east exit. Do you see the blue sign?
Take the east exit by the blue sign. Can you see it from here?
Walk straight for five minutes, then turn left. Is that clear?
Walk straight for five minutes and turn left at the bank. Would you like me to repeat that?
Is this your first time in London?
Is this your first visit to London? How are you enjoying it so far?
What was your favorite trip?
Tell me about a trip you enjoyed. Where did you go?
What did you like there?
What did you enjoy most about that trip?
Where do you want to go next?
Choose one place you want to visit next and tell me why.
I can give you a spare key or open the door for you. Which do you want?
We can lend you a temporary key or have a staff member open your door. Which would help more?
Your new key can be ready tomorrow. Is morning okay?
A replacement key can be ready tomorrow morning or afternoon. When can you pick it up?
Should we call you or send a text?
Would you like a text or a phone call when it's ready?
Let's write our names on our food. Is that okay?
We could write names on personal food and use a green sticker for shared food. What do you think?
If food has no name, should we ask before throwing it away?
For food with no name, should we ask in the group chat before throwing it away?
Should we clean the fridge on Friday or Sunday?
Would Friday or Sunday be better for cleaning the fridge?
I have your white shirt, and I think you have my blue one. Can you see it?
Our laundry got mixed up. I found your white shirt. Could you look for my blue one?
Do you want to use the dryer together?
The dryer is cheaper if we share it. Would you like to use it together or separately?
Next time, should we send a text when clothes get mixed up?
If this happens again, should we text each other or leave the clothes by the door?
Please stop using the sink. Do you need a towel or a bucket?
Please don't use the sink for now. Would you like a bucket, or help turning off the water?
We can come today at six or tomorrow at nine. Which time is good?
A worker can visit at six today or nine tomorrow. Which appointment works for you?
Should the worker call you before coming?
Would you like the worker to call or text before arriving?
Please clean the room and remove your things. Do you want a checklist?
Before the inspection, remove your things and clean the room. Would a checklist help you?
We can check the room today at three or tomorrow at ten. Which time is good?
Inspection times are three today and ten tomorrow. Which one should I reserve?
If you have photos from move-in, please bring them. If not, tell us about the old damage.
Damage may reduce your deposit. Bring any move-in photos you have. If you have none, tell us the damage was already there.
The direct train arrives at four and costs $45. The slower train arrives at five and costs $30. Which ticket do you want?
The direct train arrives at four for $45. The transfer arrives at five for $30. Which one would you like?
Do you want a paper ticket or a phone ticket?
Would you like the ticket printed or sent to your phone?
Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?
Window and aisle seats are available. Tell me your seat preference.
The pasta is not spicy. The curry is spicy. Which one do you want?
The pasta is mild and creamy, while the curry is hot and spicy. Which sounds better today?
Do you want to add chicken or extra vegetables?
You can add chicken or extra vegetables to either dish. Would you like to add one?
Write a review and get a free side. Do you want to join?
If you leave a review, you can choose a free salad or rice. Would you like to join?
The museum pass lets you visit two museums. The city pass also includes buses. Which do you want?
The museum pass covers two museums. The city pass includes museums and public transit. Which fits your plan?
You can add lunch for $15. Do you want it?
You can add lunch for $15. Would you like to include it?
Do you want a paper pass or a phone pass?
Would you like a paper pass or a digital pass on your phone?
The morning tour costs the same as your original booking. The evening tour costs $10 more. Which do you want?
Morning has a smaller group. Evening includes city lights and costs $10 more than your original booking. Which time would you prefer?
Should we send your new ticket by email or text?
Would you like the new booking confirmation by email or text?
We also have a food tour. Would you like more information?
We also offer a food tour and a night river cruise. Would you like to hear about either one?
A wider seat costs $50. The exit-row seat is free, but you must help in an emergency. Which do you want?
A seat with more legroom costs $50. The exit-row seat is free, but you must help in an emergency. Which would you prefer?
We can check your bag for free. Would you like that?
Overhead space is limited, so we can check your carry-on for free. Would you like that?
Do you want your new boarding pass on paper or on your phone?
Would you like the updated boarding pass printed or sent to your phone?
One class has a project every week. The other has two big tests. Which class sounds better?
One course has weekly projects, while the other has two large exams. Which course would suit you better?
Why is that class better for you?
What makes that course a better fit for you?
The class meets Tuesday morning or Thursday afternoon. Which time can you attend?
The class meets Tuesday morning or Thursday afternoon. Which time works with your schedule?
I heard you were sick and missed class. I have notes on the homework and examples. Which do you need first?
I heard you were sick and missed class. I took notes on the examples and homework changes. Which part do you need first?
Should I send photos or lend you my notebook?
I can send photos now or lend you the notebook later. Which would be easier?
Can you buy me a snack later?
I helped you today, so how about buying me a snack later?
You can write a three-page report or give a five-minute talk. Which one is better for you?
You can write a three-page report or give a five-minute presentation. Which format suits you better?
Why is that choice better for you?
What makes that format a better fit for you?
The work is due Friday. Can you finish by then?
The deadline is Friday at five. Can you submit it by then?
We have no fresh basil. Are you making pasta, pizza, or something else?
We're out of fresh basil today. What are you cooking so I can suggest a substitute?
Do you want dried basil or parsley? Do you want a small or large pack?
Dried basil tastes similar, while parsley tastes fresher. Both come in two sizes. Which ingredient and size would you prefer?
Tomatoes are 20 percent off. Do you want some?
Tomatoes are 20 percent off with either one. Would you like to add them?
Is your event casual or formal?
Would you describe the event as casual or formal?
Would you like navy or beige?
Both styles come in navy and beige. Which color would you like to try first?
The casual jacket cannot be returned. The dressy jacket can be returned. Which one do you want to try?
The casual jacket is final sale, but the formal blazer can be returned. Which one would you like to try?
The snack set is $15. The mug is $25. Which gift do you want?
The $15 snack set is easy to share, while the $25 mug lasts longer. Which suits your friend?
What short message should I write on the card?
We can include a free message card. What short message would you like?
Do you want free wrapping or gift wrapping for $3?
Standard wrapping is free, and gift wrapping costs $3. Which would you prefer?
Is price, weight, or sound most important to you?
What matters most to you: stronger noise canceling, lighter weight, or a lower price?
Model A has better sound for $120. Model B is lighter for $80. Which do you want?
Model A has better noise canceling for $120. Model B is lighter for $80. Which fits your needs?
Do you want black, white, or gray?
The model comes in black, white, and gray. Which color should I bring?
Do you want to ride the bike or look at it first?
You can test-ride the bike or check the scratches first. What would you like to do?
I'm asking $200, but the bike has some scratches. What price can you pay, and why?
I'm asking $200, but I can discuss the price. What price would you offer, and why?
Can you pay in cash today?
If we agree, can you pay the full price in cash today?
I'm sorry. Can we test the kettle now?
I'm sorry about the problem. May we test the kettle before we process your request?
We can give you a new one or return your money. Which do you want?
We can replace it today or refund you within five days. Which option would you prefer?
Would you like a box of tea as a gift?
We'd like to offer you a box of tea for the trouble. Would you accept it?
Are you staying for one month or longer, and do you use more data for messages or videos?
How long are you staying, and do you mainly use data for messages, maps, or videos?
Ten gigabytes costs $30. Unlimited data costs $45. Which do you want?
The 10-gigabyte plan is $30, and unlimited data is $45. Which plan fits you better?
I need your passport for the SIM. Do you want to pay the full amount now or pay automatically each month?
I need your passport to register the SIM. Would you rather pay the full amount now or set up automatic monthly payments?
